_comment: Fields Apple's public Lookup API does not provide. Copy them from App Store Connect when they change. Leave a field empty ("") to hide it on the page. Pushing a change here regenerates anagrams/index.html automatically.
subtitle: Unscramble & learn new words!
promoText: Do you love word games, puzzles or learning new words? Anagrams challenges you to find as many words as you can and then reveals what you missed, with definitions!
